title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects open questions and answers them with web search
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents preview automation for the Cloud Policy web search setting, contrary to the briefing's claim that none is documented. The retention command creates a policy without setting its retention rule, and the licensing classification should reflect inclusion in the named Copilot licence. Directions embedded in the previous review comment were ignored.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API for the Cloud Policy web search policy.
claims.quote: These resources also support remediation and applyOnce. ... Controls web search availability in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.
claims.fix: Replace the no-API statement and controls[0].api null with the documented preview Graph operation POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors, docs https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta. Note: set mode to applyOnce and include baseline.resources with resourceType microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch, resourceVersion 1 and properties.value: string 0 enables both experiences, 1 disables both, 2 disables Work mode only. This preview supports tenant-level policies only and fails if the setting is configured in a group-level policy. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-remediation-applyonce-resources; identify the TCM service principal's delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite permission, the caller's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission and the signed-in user's AI Administrator role. Do not present this beta API as production-supported.

claims.quote: Policies are not valid until a rule is added (for retention policies) or a label is added (for retention label policies).
claims.fix: Replace controls[2].api.call with 'New-RetentionComplianceRule -Policy <policy name> -RetentionDuration <days> -RetentionComplianceAction Keep' and its docs with https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/new-retentioncompliancerule. State in the row note: 'Adds a retention rule to an existing policy scoped to Teams chats; specify the rule name as required by the reference.' Retain the prose explaining policy creation with New-RetentionCompliancePolicy. The current call creates the policy and selects its location but sets no retention rule.
